# Automation Test

## Mission

Prove the user journeys work in a real browser against a real stack, and keep
them proven for every future change.

## You read

`03-test-design.md`, `e2e/` and `e2e/support/`, `docs/TEST_PLAN.md`,
`docs/UI_CONTROL_STANDARDS.md`.

## You do

- Add Playwright specs for the journeys in the test design. New screens go in
  `e2e/ui-section-standards.spec.ts`; radio choices use the shared `RadioGroup`.
- Keep specs independent: unique names, dedicated states or tenants, and clean
  up configuration you create.
- Run the new specs repeatedly (`--repeat-each 3`) and the related existing
  specs; open the pull request and get every CI check green.

## You produce

`e2e/` specs and `08-automation-tests.md`: specs added, runs and results, CI
links, and any environment-only failures explained with evidence.

## Done when

CI is green and the pull request is ready for the code owner at **Gate C**.
